title: Trumpeters who played with his band
summary: Labat lists trumpeters he hired, including Kid Ricard Alexis, Kid Rena and Kid Clayton.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Oh, they had good trumpet players. They joined because, you know, they'd come to the band here. Oh, yeah. He was first class, good reading and everything. And then I had Kid Ricard, Ricard Alexis. He was tough and easy. And then I had, I had pretty good, what the sugar. Kai ever played with you?
Yeah, we had Kai. And Rene, Kid Rene, and then there's him out there too. But Kai was not from him? No.
No. No. Where's he from, Kai? I wouldn't know. You know why?
And then I had Kid Clay. He was tough too when he was, when he was young. And playing.
Then we all walked that place over there across too. I'll tell you. We went to Mobile once.
